rows.description: Read the conversation: your messages, streamed answers with collapsible reasoning, tool calls, turn errors, and the copy action.
rows.notes: Renders all 19 chat node kinds dsh declares (user, steering, turn-trigger, assistant-step, tool-call, turn-tail, turn-error, turn-max-tokens, model-retry, system-prompt, command, command-input, context, question-reply, compaction, manual-compaction, turn-process, workflow-run, unknown). Stream behaviour matches dsh web: "Loading history…" hint while a session opens, the "Load earlier" control (read automatically as well when the reader nears the top, which dsh does not), the plain back-to-bottom chevron, follow of the latest end, copy and clock under messages (hover-revealed where a pointer can hover), tappable http(s) and file links, one selection across messages. Kept from raft-flutter without a visible change: a two-sided timeline (older pages never move the reader), per-session reading position (memory only), scrollbar thumb drag on wide windows. Raft's skeleton and the "N new" count are behind one flag (`streamExtras`, off). Not ported: the turn rail (TurnNavigator), fork-at-message (needs session/fork), like/dislike (ui-message-feedback), secret masking (ui-secret-mask), URLs written as inline code, the link glyph, selection that survives rows leaving the built range (the list is lazy). System-prompt cards now interpret system messages, positional replacements and request-series anchors, with bounded plain-text disclosures; they remain outside the normal transcript per upstream visibility in every display mode; raw request inspection belongs to Trajectory. Model retry chains are correlated by producer retryId; scheduled, started and boundary-cancelled states, a client-clock countdown and expandable failure details are implemented. Automatic compaction markers require a landed checkpoint and use only its loaded summary evidence; shadowed transcript remains visible. Manual compaction is folded into its command identity, including partial-window fallbacks. Ordinary commands use a command-name keyed seat and retain complete plain-text settlements; multiline output expands. Compaction summaries expand as Markdown with a header pinned within their row. Turn process controls fold only eligible completed ranges and preserve the final reply, partial-window boundaries and interleaved input. Four work-detail modes and independent completion/next-input timing are Host-backed; process groups split reasoning and response references without duplicating node data. Coordinated collapse animation, nested-group pagination compensation and some text/Markdown fidelity remain follow-up work. Goal command inputs are projected separately from command results; answered late question replies exclusively own their source messages and copy the full answer. Context disclosures support instructions, catalog, snapshot, notice, relay and recall with all-or-nothing opaque fallbacks and bounded bodies. Ordinary contexts remain hidden, while tool additions/removals retain upstream visibility. Workflow runs keep durable run/member outcomes and collision-free phase identities, distinguish normal foreground closure from abandoned turns, and defer clean collapse while member focus remains inside.

Busy-Enter preferences are Host-backed; Enter/Send share delivery intent, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter uses its opposite, and empty accelerated Enter steers queued occurrences in order.
